decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting information regarding the spouse of John Brinsley Brooks. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S9) explicitly states he married 'Anna of Holstein-Gottorp' in 1575. Document 2 (D2S2, D2S7) explicitly states he is married to 'Lucinda Mary Fane de Salis', born in 1938. These represent two distinct temporal contexts (16th century vs. modern era) or potentially contradictory narratives within the source text. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and not silently equate competing assertions, both names are included as they are directly asserted as spouses in the respective source segments.
